events.what: Punjab Legislative Assembly (117 seats): the Election Commission lists the current term as 17 March 2022 to 16 March 2027. A general election is due before the term ends; the schedule has not been announced.
events.effect: Election period: the Model Code of Conduct, heavy campaigning and some liquor-sale dry days around polling.
